# ai

> Model-pinned ZCode and Codex harness kits plus cross-harness skill
> categories. No installer, no build step, no dependencies: an AI agent
> pointed at this repo installs it by following the procedures below.

Layout: harness-specific kits under `harness/` (`zcode/`, `codex/`);
other top-level directories except `research/` (`copy/`, `coding/`, `languages/rust/`, `product/`, `testing/`)
are cross-harness skill categories. To install, follow [install.md](install.md),
which enforces a strict **Global Core vs Per-Project Niche** split:
- **Global Core (`~/.zcode/` and `~/.agents/skills/`)**: only the 7 core agents
  (`general-pro`, `general-flash`, `explore-flash`, `workflow-author`,
  `workflow-author-flash`, `workflow-planner`, `workflow-planner-flash`), the 5 general ZCode skills (`z-workflow`, `z-proflow`,
  `z-flashflow`, `z-liteflow`, `z-project-init`), and the 5 universal baseline
  skills (`antislop-copy`, `code-comments`, `test-quality-guardrails`,
  `test-quality-tdd-agents`, `test-quality-audit`).
- **Per-Project Niche (`<project>/.zcode/` and `<project>/.agents/skills/`, via `z-project-init`)**:
  niche `z-*` specialists, niche workflows (`z-gpui-workflow`,
  `z-tauri-workflow`, `z-super-rustflow`, `shipflow`), and stack-specific domain
  skills (`languages/rust/rust-*` and external framework skills) install only into
  the project that uses them and record their `hmziqrs/ai` commit SHA and file
  hashes in `<project>/.zcode/hmziqrs-ai-snapshot.json`.
Agent definitions must be regular files — ZCode's discovery silently skips symlinks;
`find ~/.zcode/agents -type l` and `find <project>/.zcode/agents -type l` printing
nothing confirms none.

`research/` is excluded from installation and routine exploration. Read it only
when the user explicitly requests research material or the task is research-related.
Follow the hard rule in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## ZCode kit (`harness/zcode/`)

- [harness/zcode/agents/general-flash.md](harness/zcode/agents/general-flash.md): full-tools general agent pinned to glm-5.3-flash — objectively checkable work (CRUD, boilerplate, mechanical verification).
- [harness/zcode/agents/explore-flash.md](harness/zcode/agents/explore-flash.md): read-only search + code-audit agent pinned to glm-5.3-flash — reports findings, no verdict authority.
- [harness/zcode/agents/general-pro.md](harness/zcode/agents/general-pro.md): full-tools judgment agent pinned to glm-5.3 — complex implementation, audit verdicts, continue/stop decisions.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/SKILL.md): the general dynamic-workflow composer — for small work the workflow-author explores directly, for larger work the workflow-planner gathers every fact (signals, files, specialists) into the WorkflowBrief and dispatches the author, keeping the coordinator's context clean; the workflow-author writes a fresh script per task from measured signals, work lands on run-owned branches, with guarded automatic fast-forward into the user's checkout.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/persona-kit.dwf.ts](harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/persona-kit.dwf.ts): the shared persona kit — paste it unchanged into any workflow script to drive subagents with agent files (loadPersona, personaAgent, guardWrites, personaReport); workflows cannot call agents by name.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-proflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-proflow/SKILL.md): z-workflow on the pro model only, with no vision — every role on GLM-5.3, no Flash anywhere, visible requirements checked by commands or listed as not covered.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-flashflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-flashflow/SKILL.md): z-workflow on Flash only — every role, including the workflow-author, on GLM-5.3-Flash; judge verdicts stay labelled judged.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-liteflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-liteflow/SKILL.md): the fast small-task form of z-workflow — no explorers and no author: the coordinator fills a pre-tested one-lane template (implement, gate, flash tracer, fresh pro judge); bigger tasks hand off to z-workflow.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-project-init/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-project-init/SKILL.md): per-project ZCode initializer and snapshot manager — inspects project manifests, installs only the required niche `z-*` sub-agents (`.zcode/agents/`), niche workflows (`.zcode/skills/`), and domain skills (`.agents/skills/`), and writes `.zcode/hmziqrs-ai-snapshot.json` for drift detection and isolated per-project updates while keeping the 7 core agents global.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-gpui-workflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-gpui-workflow/SKILL.md): GPUI (`gpui-kit`) domain profile of z-workflow — fresh script per task, `z-gpui-engineer` and companion Rust/verification specialists loaded via `persona-kit.dwf.ts` v4, crate-scoped Cargo and `#[gpui_kit::test]` UI integration gates, and serialized `V=desktop` capture via `z-native-device-verifier` (`open-computer-use` AX tree + PNG) with blind Flash vision audit before guarded Step 6 fast-forward delivery.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-tauri-workflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-tauri-workflow/SKILL.md): Tauri v2 domain profile of z-workflow — fresh script per task separating Rust Core (`src-tauri/`), IPC/capability contracts, and static Frontend areas, `z-tauri-integrator` and framework specialists loaded via `persona-kit.dwf.ts` v4, scoped Cargo and package-manager gates, and explicit two-surface runtime verification (`V=web` browser lane vs serialized `V=desktop`/`V=mobile` `z-native-device-verifier` lane) before guarded Step 6 fast-forward delivery.
- [harness/zcode/skills/z-super-rustflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/z-super-rustflow/SKILL.md): Rust super-optimization campaign over the `rust-*` performance and soundness skill suite — read-only research phase by default (`z-rust-perf-engineer`, `z-rust-memory-engineer`, `z-rust-simd-engineer`, `z-rust-async-engineer`, `z-unsafe-ffi-auditor` via `persona-kit.dwf.ts` v4, zero edits), opt-in implement phase with a converge-until-auditors-go-silent audit-fix loop and guarded Step 6 delivery; Pro only, no vision, no Flash.
- [harness/zcode/skills/shipflow/SKILL.md](harness/zcode/skills/shipflow/SKILL.md): framework-agnostic z-workflow profile for a GitHub issue queue — one issue per cycle, each cycle a fresh z-workflow run on the COMPLEX path (workflow-planner gathers the facts) with the normal approval dialog, a run-owned `wf/shipflow-<N>` worktree, planner-discovered gates, and one documented non-force push of the run-owned branch; merge policy lives in script code. Per-project niche, installed via z-project-init.

The ZCode kit also supplies reusable `z-*` domain and verification personas,
including three stack-agnostic agents that Shipflow uses: `z-product-owner`
(read-only PRD, backlog, triage and status judgement that returns op plans),
`z-qa-evaluator` (skeptical browser QA against acceptance criteria with a
calibrated rubric), and `z-security-auditor` (read-only diff security audit).
GitHub mechanics are code, not agents: the GitHub kit
`harness/zcode/skills/shipflow/github-kit.dwf.ts` is pasted unchanged into cycle
scripts. Use [specialist routing](harness/zcode/skills/z-workflow/references/specialists.md)
with discovered agent descriptions; the coordinator supplies explicit role authority,
acceptance evidence and available skill paths.

## Cross-harness skill categories

Every top-level directory except `harness/` and `research/` is a category
holding plain-SKILL.md skills (no harness tooling). Category skills install
for every harness; research archives never install.

- [copy/antislop-copy/SKILL.md](copy/antislop-copy/SKILL.md): cuts consumer-facing website copy to the shortest version that still answers the visitor's questions, without inventing or bending facts.
- [coding/code-comments/SKILL.md](coding/code-comments/SKILL.md): hard comment discipline for agent-written code — use whenever writing or editing code in any language, even when the request never mentions comments. Zero comments by default; names, types, structure, and tests carry the meaning. Only public-API contract docs, convention-required SAFETY blocks, and link-carrying last-resort constraint notes survive, never longer than 2 lines (3 absolute max). Bans narration, section banners, change-log and AI-voice comments.
- [coding/test-quality-guardrails/SKILL.md](coding/test-quality-guardrails/SKILL.md): stop AI agents from generating bloated, low-value unit tests — rules-file policies with copy-paste CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.cursorrules blocks: default-off test generation, read-only failing tests (never modify or delete a failing test to make it pass), targeted runs in the agent loop with the full suite in CI/hooks, and when tests are worth explicitly asking for.
- [coding/test-quality-tdd-agents/SKILL.md](coding/test-quality-tdd-agents/SKILL.md): tests-first workflows for AI coding agents — the confirm-fail red-green loop with tests frozen during implementation, humans writing or reviewing the tests as the spec, characterization tests for legacy code, and property-based testing as the better agent assignment than hand-written example tests.
- [coding/test-quality-audit/SKILL.md](coding/test-quality-audit/SKILL.md): audit and prune AI-written test suites — mutation testing as the quality gate, coverage as a vanity metric, implementation-coupling and mirroring smells, the "not too many, mostly integration" mix, risk-based coverage allocation, and a promote/flag/delete triage runbook.
- [languages/rust/rust-superopt/SKILL.md](languages/rust/rust-superopt/SKILL.md): entry point for "make this Rust faster" — benchmarks-first triage across compute vs memory vs lock vs IO, release-profile hygiene, measurement discipline, and codegen-inspection/PGO/BOLT tooling; routes to the sibling rust skills.
- [languages/rust/rust-simd-crates/SKILL.md](languages/rust/rust-simd-crates/SKILL.md): adopt an existing SIMD-accelerated crate (JSON, hashing, compression, UTF-8 validation, base64/hex, CRC, FFT/BLAS, crypto, image codecs, search) instead of hand-writing kernels — selection, runtime-vs-compile-time dispatch caveats, feature-flag swaps, serde_json → simd-json/sonic-rs migration.
- [languages/rust/rust-simd-kernels/SKILL.md](languages/rust/rust-simd-kernels/SKILL.md): hand-written SIMD/vector kernels when crates and the autovectorizer are not enough — std::simd / core::simd / wide / pulp, C-intrinsic ports, `#[target_feature]` and runtime dispatch, codegen verification with cargo-show-asm / llvm-mca / LLVM remarks.
- [languages/rust/rust-parallel-cache/SKILL.md](languages/rust/rust-parallel-cache/SKILL.md): parallel and cache-friendly Rust — rayon pool configuration, work-stealing vs pinned-shard design, false-sharing measurement and padding, cache tiling, NUMA first-touch, Apple Silicon QoS/E-core steering.
- [languages/rust/rust-fast-architecture/SKILL.md](languages/rust/rust-fast-architecture/SKILL.md): architecture-level speed for whole Rust services — contention math, single-writer actors, lock downgrade at commit, write-behind group commit, adaptive linger, pooling, deterministic simulation testing, async-runtime chooser (glommio/monoio/compio/tokio).
- [product/prd-authoring/SKILL.md](product/prd-authoring/SKILL.md): staged pipeline for writing or amending a PRD that agents build from — levels, stable IDs, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, lint and critic gates.
- [product/site-recon/SKILL.md](product/site-recon/SKILL.md): read-only reconnaissance of a public reference website into a discovery pack — archetypes, captures, data model, journeys, gated-area assumptions, parity spec.
- [testing/parity-testing/SKILL.md](testing/parity-testing/SKILL.md): reference-parity tests for a website clone — aria-snapshot structure matching, masked pixel diffs of static chrome, journey replay, per-archetype parity scores, noise and sensitivity calibration.

## Codex kit (`harness/codex/`)

Installs the Z.ai Responses provider, five custom agents, six profiles,
a two-model catalog, and four skills while preserving the normal OpenAI
default. The `ZAI_API_KEY` import goes into the private Codex-only
`~/.codex/secrets/zai-api-key` file with mode `0600`; provider
authentication reads that file, and the key never enters Git or
`~/.codex/config.toml`. Full procedure:
[harness/codex/install.md](harness/codex/install.md).

- [harness/codex/agents](harness/codex/agents): `zai_flash`, `zai_vision`, `zai_pro`, and `zai_reviewer` at max reasoning, plus a low-effort read-only explorer.
- [harness/codex/plugins/zai-workflows](harness/codex/plugins/zai-workflows): publishable Codex plugin containing z-workflow, z-proflow, z-flashflow, and z-liteflow.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): full documentation — layout, categories, install paths, how to add skills/kits/harnesses.
- [install.md](install.md): the ZCode-kit + categories install procedure an AI agent executes.
- [.zcode-plugin/plugin.json](.zcode-plugin/plugin.json): install as a ZCode plugin (Settings → Plugin Management → Discover → + → this Git URL) — the only plugin route; the ZCode kit's agents and skills are harness-specific and are never published to other harnesses' plugin/marketplace systems.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): orientation for AI agents working IN this repository (layout, conventions, extension rules).
